main_text.head: PRAEFATIO
main_text.p: [illegible, ~60 letters] gere, cùm ipse in R. Salomone istiusmodi nihil inveniam. Deducit ille potiùs à [illegible, ~5 letters] asseritus Jod esse de radice ut in [illegible, ~8 letters] Ezech. 8. quod est à [illegible, ~3 letters], ut ipse ignorat in Lexico suo Forberus. Verba autem R. Salomonis, quae id quod nixi innuunt, haec sunt [illegible, ~20 letters] [illegible, ~25 letters] (sic in Lexicon eiusdem, quia sic in Bibliis cùm ex tamen sic regiminis forma, extra regimen autem scribi debeat [illegible, ~12 letters] minùs quodam modo deducit à [illegible, ~4 letters], quod eorum seu concisionem designat, ut rompi fit pro [illegible, ~6 letters], ubi primò ex [illegible, ~4 letters] litterarum Metathesi fit [illegible, ~4 letters], unde praeter Jod in & additoo sine He, sic [illegible, ~10 letters] ex regimine litterae [illegible, ~6 letters] scripto sunt tamen hanc quàm per dagesh supplento [illegible, ~10 letters] In hunc modum Forberus similiter pro [illegible, ~8 letters] derivatio pilleo longè petita, adeoque tortas ac violentas, ut [illegible, ~6 letters] etiam dicit ille [illegible, ~12 letters] quo rem [illegible, ~10 letters] ponitur, Hoc tamen vocabulum illud quod primo fuerat id significat non de ipsis significatione, sed de ipsa pure, ex Syna. [illegible, ~20 letters] Judaeorum Synagogam et [illegible, ~5 letters] portarum. Nec minus quam eo in ipsa significatione [illegible, ~12 letters] dicere supra rem [illegible, ~6 letters] Jod ex eis ut de iis significare conspectu; quam nec [illegible, ~5 letters] in [illegible, ~10 letters] de quo ipsa exigua lapillo, cuius in aedificatione [illegible, ~8 letters] imo de lapide pretioso ut Exod. 28. 17. usurpari; nec nihil [illegible, ~6 letters] cum aliis Graecis quoque regulis valeamus dicere volumus. Aleph in [illegible, ~8 letters] Hebraeis non

page.notes: The scan is very blurred and show-through from the facing page is heavy; most of the text is illegible. The right edge strip belongs to the facing page and is mostly cut off. Marginal notes on the left are faint and mostly unreadable. Hebrew and Greek words appear in the text but could not be read reliably, so they are marked illegible.
